# Deployment parameter regression fixtures

These snapshots come from `lazycat-contrib/pansou-lzcapp`:

- `pansou-enum.yml`: commit `da211ce3186f8a0ed795f1562d15015f45bdf34d`, containing the unsupported `enum` type and `options` fields.
- `pansou-bool.yml`: commit `dd36f3dc87827f10b75b00265e9c3447a5c6210b`, replacing `enum` with `bool` and removing the unsupported parameter/locale options.

Contract reference: https://developer.lazycat.cloud/spec/deploy-params.html
